parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small rubber button on the remote control, typically circular and slightly raised.
parts.Functional_description: Used to send specific commands when pressed, such as power or volume control.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position due to elasticity.
